decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory linked to the installed trailer base, it likely meets modest aspiration levels and requires little organisational slack, so there is limited pressure to withdraw it.

The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's core professional hauling business and, having survived the earlier review while resources were tightened elsewhere, would typically be retained unless results clearly fell below aspiration.

Although model-line rationalisation remains possible in box trailers, this series appears to have survived internal comparison and now likely justifies continuation as the better-fitting option within the portfolio.
